Subject: Re: Allscripts — Demo slot Wed 21st (portal items outstanding)

Hi Maya / Aditya,

Quick update from procurement: our vendor portal flagged a number of missing fields in Redwood's security questionnaire (particularly around data retention and key management). Legal needs those filled and an executed NDA before the technical demo. We were hoping to keep the Wed 21st slot, but procurement says they can't allow live credentials until the portal is complete.

Also a heads up: our security lead (Brian) will be travelling Tues–Thu for a summit and may only be available for a short portion of the demo if we don't move it.

Can we push the demo until next week? If you can send a completed copy of the questionnaire (or point me to a shared version with answers) I can expedite intake. I attached the portal checklist we received.

Thanks,
Samantha
Program Manager, Strategic Partnerships
Allscripts

Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Allscripts — Demo slot Wed 21st (portal items outstanding)

Hi Samantha — thanks for the heads-up and for attaching the checklist.

We can absolutely pause the live demo until procurement confirms the portal intake. Aditya and I will get the questionnaire back to you today with answers for the data retention and KMS fields. Neha, I’ve looped you for any additional evidence or a short note about our key management options (KMS + HSM integrations).

Proposed next steps:
- Internal: Aditya + Maya to complete vendor_questionnaire_v2.docx and upload to your portal by EOD.
- Security: Neha to provide a one-page summary of key-management options and retention policy by EOD.
- Scheduling: If portal intake clears, propose demo on Mon 26th or Tue 27th morning (PDT). If Brian is only partial on Mon/Tue, we can run the demo for product/engineering and schedule a 30-min follow-up with Brian.

Would either Mon 26th 10:00–11:00 PDT or Tue 27th 09:00–10:00 PDT work?

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Brian Lee <blee@allscripts.com>

Thanks for the rapid reply. I can confirm I’ll be travelling Wed but should be back (and fully available) by Mon 26th afternoon. If you can do the demo Mon 26th 10–11 PDT that would actually work better for me — I can join remotely.

One caveat from procurement/legal: they need the questionnaire answers uploaded into the portal (not via email) so the intake checks can run. Samantha — I saw the vendor portal link in the Doc you sent; can you grant Maya/Aditya contributor access for the form? That will speed things up.

Safe travels to those on the road.
Brian
Director, IT Security
Allscripts

- I uploaded a completed vendor_questionnaire_v2.docx to the portal draft and flagged the data-retention/KMS answers per the checklist. Link: https://vendor-portal.allscripts.com/forms/12345 (uploaded as "redwood_questionnaire_filled.docx").
- Neha attached a short evidence note (see below) and I also uploaded the DocuSign NDA stub to your portal (requested e-signature).

Neha — can you confirm the summary text I placed in the portal is accurate? If all good, Samantha, please confirm procurement will re-run intake and advise next steps.

If intake clears, Maya — happy to confirm Mon 26th 10:00–11:00 PDT. If procurement says we still need an alternate slot, we can push to Tue 27th morning as backup.

Thanks,

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Allscripts — Demo slot Wed 21st (portal items outstanding)

Samantha / Brian —

Thanks — I reviewed the portal upload and the answers for KMS and retention look accurate. Short summary for your intake team (you can copy to the portal comment field):
- KMS: We support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and bring-your-own HSM for on-prem/private deployments; keys are isolated per-tenant.
- Retention: Default retention for ephemeral inference logs is 30 days; customers can configure retention to 0 days or a custom policy depending on contract.

We also attached the relevant policy excerpt to the portal upload. Once procurement confirms the intake checks pass we can proceed with the Mon 26th 10:00 PDT demo. If anything else is required for evidence, let us know and we’ll prioritize.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Security Architect, Redwood Inference

Attachment: vendor_questionnaire_v2.docx (evidence excerpts included)
